screening.reason: Inclusion 3: describes the ABIDE II release itself (cohort composition, sites, diagnosis determination, QC metrics, access).

evidence_spans.text:
a new multi-site open data resource containing 1,044 independent datasets (ASD N = 487;
Controls N = 557)
evidence_spans.claim: ABIDE II aggregates 1,044 datasets: 487 ASD and 557 controls.

evidence_spans.text:
The current ABIDE II dataset encompasses 17 collections of unique independent datasets (i.e., from
individuals whose data were not previously shared in ABIDE I) yielding 487 datasets classiﬁed as ASD
and 557 as controls (Fig. 1a, Table 1). These represent previously collected datasets across 16 sites,
including nine charter ABIDE I institutions and seven new members
evidence_spans.claim: ABIDE II comprises 17 collections across 16 sites (9 ABIDE I charter sites plus 7 new sites).

evidence_spans.text:
ASD classiﬁcation was determined by either 1) combining clinical judgment with ‘gold standard’
diagnostic instruments—Autism Diagnostic Observation Scale34,35 and/or Autism Diagnostic Interview-
Revised36 [ADOS, ADI-R]; (n = 12 data collections; 368 ASD datasets) or 2) by using these ‘gold
standard’ diagnostic instruments only (n = 4 collections; 92 ASD datasets)
evidence_spans.claim: ASD diagnosis across collections was based on clinical judgment plus ADOS/ADI-R, or ADOS/ADI-R alone, varying by collection.

evidence_spans.text:
we used the Preprocessed Connectome Project quality assurance protocol49
(http://preprocessed-connectomes-project.github.io)
evidence_spans.claim: Data quality was assessed using the Preprocessed Connectomes Project QA protocol, including mean framewise displacement.

evidence_spans.text:
users regardless of data quality27. The rationale of this decision includes the lack of consensus on optimal
quality criteria in regards to speciﬁc measures or their combinations and cutoffs.
evidence_spans.claim: ABIDE II releases all datasets regardless of QC metric values, with no enforced exclusion threshold, because there is no consensus on quality cutoffs.

evidence_spans.text:
All ABIDE II datasets can be accessed, after establishing a login and user password, through FCP/INDI
at the Neuroimaging Informatics Tools and Resources Clearinghouse (NITRC; http://fcon_1000.projects.
nitrc.org/indi/abide/). The datasets are organized by data collection and stored in.tar ﬁles, each
containing imaging and phenotypic data.
evidence_spans.claim: ABIDE II data (imaging and phenotypic) are openly accessible via NITRC after registration.

evidence_spans.text:
The ABIDE II sample has increased the number of available datasets from females with
ASD from 65 in ABIDE I to 138 when ABIDE I+II are combined.
evidence_spans.claim: ABIDE II substantially increases the number of female ASD datasets available (65 to 138 combined with ABIDE I).

evidence_spans.text:
Finally, to facilitate replications among studies using ABIDE data, we encourage users to provide
the ID list utilized for their published manuscripts in the manuscript section of the ABIDE
website (http://fcon_1000.projects.nitrc.org/indi/abide/manusc
evidence_spans.claim: The authors encourage publishing the exact participant ID list used, to support reconstructibility of analysed cohorts.

assessments.support: Per-collection inclusion/exclusion criteria (IQ range, first-degree relative with ASD, absence of seizure/genetic syndromes) are documented per collection narrative, though they vary across collections: "Other speciﬁc inclusion/exclusion criteria used for selecting controls (e.g., IQ range, ﬁrst degree relative with ASD) or ASD (e.g., absence of reported seizure and genetic syndromes) varied across collections."
Demographics, sites, scanners, and collection-level N are tabulated (Table 1, Fig. 1).
No connectivity pipeline is applied in this descriptor; raw/minimally processed acquisition parameters only.
ASD classification basis (ADOS/ADI-R and/or clinical judgment) reported per collection group with Ns.
Age, sex, site, handedness and motion (mean FD etc.) are reported and released per dataset.
QC metrics are released but deliberately not used to exclude or adjust data: "users regardless of data quality".
No connectivity outcome analysed; this is a data-release descriptor.
No inferential group analysis beyond basic demographic comparisons (e.g., handedness) is the focus.

risk_of_bias.summary: As a data descriptor, cohort composition, diagnosis basis and QC metrics are transparently reported per collection; analytical domains are not applicable since no connectivity analysis is performed.

charting.title: Enhancing studies of the connectome in autism using the autism brain imaging data exchange II
charting.authors: Adriana Di Martino; David A. O'Connor; Bosi Chen; et al.
charting.primary_focus: Data descriptor / cohort and release description
charting.diagnosis_assessment: ADOS and/or ADI-R combined with clinical judgment (n=12 collections, 368 ASD datasets), or ADOS/ADI-R alone (n=4 collections, 92 ASD datasets); EMC_1 based on prior medical records

charting.dataset_available_request: No request needed beyond NITRC login
charting.sensitive_data_anonymized: Yes — HIPAA de-identification, facial information removed from structural images
charting.summary_key_findings: Describes the ABIDE II release (1,044 datasets: 487 ASD, 557 controls across 17 collections/16 sites), diagnosis basis, phenotypic measures, and QC metrics (Preprocessed Connectomes Project protocol) released without an exclusion threshold.
charting.reviewer_notes: Pure data descriptor; no autism-vs-control connectivity analysis performed in this paper itself.

narrative_row.study_design_sample_dataset: Data descriptor; ABIDE II release; N=487 ASD, N=557 controls (1,044 datasets total) across 17 collections and 16 sites (9 ABIDE I charter sites + 7 new).
narrative_row.methods: Describes data contribution, anonymization, and aggregation procedures across sites; diagnosis basis per collection (ADOS/ADI-R and/or clinical judgment); QC assessed with the Preprocessed Connectomes Project protocol (spatial and temporal metrics including mean FD) but not used to exclude data.
narrative_row.outcomes: Cohort composition, demographic and phenotypic variable availability (SRS, RBS-R, ADOS/ADI-R), and QC metric distributions by collection are reported; no group-difference or classification analysis is performed.
narrative_row.key_limitations: Heterogeneity across sites in inclusion/exclusion criteria, scanners and acquisition parameters; no consensus QC threshold is applied, so users must select/exclude data themselves.
narrative_row.relevance_notes: Defines the ABIDE II release structure (collections, sites, Ns, diagnosis basis, QC metrics) that downstream analysis papers subset from; central for linking any ABIDE II-using publication to its data provenance.
